ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio with approximately 20% high-intensity white/light-grey pixels relative to 80% low-intensity dark-grey/black pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dark base layer (low intensity) with a dense distribution of white annular/circular motifs (high intensity) concentrated in the central regions and terminal clusters on the outer lobe tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow V-shaped notch with an estimated interior angle of 145 degrees and moderate bounding-box depth.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrated boundary with pixel-amplitude variations forming a jagged profile along the entire length of the trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Composite curve exhibiting initial concavity from the median notch transitioning into a broad convexity toward the distal lobe tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density spatial distribution of circular and annular white pixel clusters (scarring) across the entirety of the visible dark ventral surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Presence of thin, high-contrast linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) crossing the natural pigmentation, most visible on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent calcified clusters (barnacles) localized on the trailing edge and distal tips of both the left and right lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Extensive white stippling and 'ring' patterns providing a highly unique, non-uniform texture across the fluke surface.
